posts.zh:
dsh-recall 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。对话历史回忆：字面/模糊/语义三层检索全部历史会话的原始文本，完全本地离线——AI 再也不会忘记你说的话。一条命令安装（自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`），语义推理跑在 worker 线程。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6cb6d70db872f87ea32d.html
posts.en:
dsh-recall is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Conversation history recall for DSH: three-layer (literal/fuzzy/semantic) retrieval over every past session's original text, fully local & offline — AI never forgets what you told it. One-command install via `dsh.bundle.patch`, semantic layer runs in a worker thread.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6cb6d70db872f87ea32d.html
